# Wake of a cylinder

The flow behind a circular cylinder separates at moderate Reynolds number.
Past a critical value the wake becomes unstable and sheds vortices.

The shedding frequency is measured with a hot wire placed downstream.
Its value, made dimensionless, is the Strouhal number of the wake.

A global mode analysis then gives the growth rate of each perturbation.
The leading eigenvalue crosses the axis at the critical Reynolds number.
